mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.store_id, h.terminal_id, h.member_id, h.item_count, h.amount, h.remark, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_time, t.name AS terminal_name, u.nickname AS cashier_name, m.name AS member_name FROM pos_held_sale h LEFT JOIN pos_terminal t ON t.id = h.terminal_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = h.create_by LEFT JOIN pos_member m ON m.id = h.member_id WHERE h.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY h.id DESC
